description.zh: WAF规则的ID，可通过调用[ListWafRules](~~2878257~~)接口获取。
description.en: The ID of the WAF rule. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListWafRules](~~2878257~~) operation.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

description.zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0。
description.en: The version number of the site configuration. If configuration version management is enabled, this parameter specifies the site version to which the configuration applies. The default value is 0.
